test_title: PYST 1: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: How does the BRICS Vaccine R&D Center support vaccine affordability?

options.text: By reducing production costs through joint research
By focusing only on high-income countries

solution:
The correct answer is __**By reducing production costs through joint research**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **BRICS Vaccine R&D Center** was formally launched on **22 March 2022** through a virtual ceremony hosted by **China**, with the participation of health ministers from **Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa**.
 
• The center serves as a collaborative platform for **joint research, development, and commercialization** of vaccines. By pooling resources and expertise, the member nations aim to **reduce production costs** and minimize the financial burden of individual research efforts. *Hence, the statement regarding reducing costs through joint research is correct.*
 
• A primary goal of this initiative is to ensure **vaccine affordability** and **equitable access**, especially for developing nations and **low-income countries**, treating vaccines as a **global public good**.
 
• The center facilitates **technology transfer** and **information sharing** among national vaccine centers. This prevents the duplication of efforts and speeds up the transition from **laboratory research** to **mass production**.
 
• The collaboration leverages the unique strengths of each member, such as **India's** massive **manufacturing capacity** and **Russia's** advancements in **vector-based vaccines**, to provide **cost-effective healthcare solutions** globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **BRICS Partnership:** The **BRICS** group (**Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa**) represents about **42%** of the **global population** and over **23%** of the **global GDP**. The group focuses on **multilateral cooperation** in fields like trade, health, and security.
 
• **Health Cooperation:** During the **13th BRICS Summit** in **2021**, chaired by **India**, member nations emphasized the need for a **BRICS Integrated Early Warning System** for preventing mass infectious disease risks.
 
• **Countering Restrictions:** Unlike the suggestion of increasing **patent restrictions**, **India** and **South Africa** have been leading voices at the **World Trade Organization (WTO)** for a **TRIPS waiver** (Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights) to allow easier and cheaper production of **COVID-19 vaccines**.
 
• **Role of India:** Known as the **Pharmacy of the World**, **India** supplies over **60%** of the world's vaccine demand. Through the **Vaccine Maitri** initiative, **India** supplied millions of doses to various **nations**, reinforcing the **BRICS** commitment to global health.
 
• **Future Pandemic Preparedness:** The **Vaccine R&D Center** is designed to act as a **networked center** to respond rapidly to future outbreaks by establishing a **standardized framework** for **clinical trials** and **emergency use authorizations**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Launch Date:** The official launch took place on **March 22, 2022**, during the tenure of **Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya** as the **Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare** of **India**.
 
• **Eliminating Barriers:** The center actively works against **vaccine nationalism** and **export limits**, promoting the idea that **global recovery** is only possible when **vaccines** are accessible to all, regardless of a **country's** economic status.
 
• **Technical Network:** It involves key institutions like the **Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)** from **India** and similar premier health bodies from other **member states** to ensure **scientific excellence** and **data transparency**.
 
• **Expansion:** The **BRICS** bloc recently expanded in **2024** to include **Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, and the United Arab Emirates**, which is expected to further broaden the scope and impact of the **Vaccine R&D Center**.
